label: TP
reason: User input from getQueryString() is URL-decoded but never HTML-encoded before being written to the response body via Writer.print(). The X-XSS-Protection header is disabled ('0'), confirming a reflected XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: URLDecoder.decode decodes percent-encoding but does not sanitize HTML special characters.
Unsanitized user data 'bar' is printed directly to the HTML response body.
Header 'X-XSS-Protection' is set to '0', disabling browser-side XSS filtering.
